meta.description: Luna's Eat & Drink in Orange Beach, AL. Fresh seafood meets soulful Southern goodness at Luna's Eat & Drink in Orange Beach. This restaurant blends coastal fare and hometown favorites in a family‑friendly setting, with a grassy courtyard for outdoor games, 32 craft beers on tap, live music, and Southern hospitality.
